test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Obliterate
solution:
The correct answer is **Abolish**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **most appropriate** synonym for the given word '**Obliterate**' is '**Abolish**'.
 
• The meaning of the word '**Obliterate**' is '**to remove all signs of something by destroying or covering it completely**'.
 
• The meaning of the word '**Abolish**' is '**to end a law or system officially; extinguish, eliminate, etc.**'
 
• Hence, the **most appropriate** answer is '**Abolish**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the other options.
 
 
• **Patched**- to cover a hole in clothes, etc. with a piece of material in order to repair it.
 
• **Healed**- to become healthy again; to make something healthy again.
 
• **Mended**- to repair something that is damaged or broken.
